reasons.plausibility: Ceria doping to enhance oxygen storage and improve PGM dispersion is well-documented and scientifically sound for automotive catalysts.
reasons.testability: Comparing control and CeO2-doped catalysts under identical exhaust conditions is a straightforward, decisive test of the proposed improvement.
reasons.usefulness: Although ceria-based improvements are known, specifically targeting reduced PGM loading while maintaining performance remains highly relevant and practical for catalyst research.
